title: Rate History Schedule: Whole Life Insurance Loan Interest by Policy Series at Anniversary Capitalization
content:
On an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, the annual rate at which an anniversary capitalization charges interest is set by the policy series that the issue date falls in.

## Schedule

| Policy series (issue date on the policy record) | Annual rate charged at an anniversary capitalization |
|---|---|
| Issued before January 1, 1990 | 8% (0.08) |
| Issued from January 1, 1990 through December 31, 2004 | 7% (0.07) |
| Issued on or after January 1, 2005 | The tier's loan interest rate |

For the series issued on or after January 1, 2005 the tier's loan interest rate is 8% on the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life, 6% on the Paid-Up at 100, Paid-Up at 65, 20-Pay and 10-Pay tiers, and 5% on the Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life.

## Series boundaries (hypothetical issue dates)

| Issue date | Series rate |
|---|---|
| December 31, 1989 | 8% |
| January 1, 1990 | 7% |
| December 31, 2004 | 7% |
| January 1, 2005, on a 20-Pay policy | 6% |

The series is fixed by the issue date of the whole life policy itself; the tier only matters for policies issued on or after January 1, 2005.
